Delicious food and wonderful service!
Sep 2026 • Family
We’re visiting Ho Chi Minh City from Melbourne, Australia 🇦🇺 and came to L’Entrecôte – Social Meating on the recommendation of one of my wife’s co-workers, who is a local. What a great recommendation!

The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, full of flavour and beautifully prepared. Everything we had was thoroughly enjoyable, and the atmosphere made it a lovely family dinner.

A special mention to our server, Thanh, who was wonderful — very friendly, attentive and welcoming. His excellent service really added to our experience.

A fantastic meal and wonderful hospitality. We’ll definitely recommend L’Entrecôte to others visiting Ho Chi Minh City!

To be refined
Sep 2026 • Solo
This restaurant is located at the top of a staircase that is scary to use.
Before arriving at a magnificent restaurant dining room.
I find it a shame that for a French restaurant, there is no menu in French and no one speaks French; not everyone speaks English, me for example😊
I had an aperitif, a Ricard; it's a shame there was nothing to snack on with it.
Foie gras as a starter, very original, although I find the balance between the foie gras and the salad off; too much salad compared to the foie gras.
Pepper steak as a main course, excellent; fries very good; I find that 180 is a bit tight given the quality of the meat.
Crème brûlée good. 
However, I sent back my steak and fries because I hadn't finished my aperitif and hadn't started the starter when they brought me the main course.
I recommend this restaurant, although I find that it needs a few adjustments.
And a fresh coat of paint in the stairwell wouldn't be a luxury😜
